dish: chinmi from across Japan (crocodile, ostrich, catfish among ~230 delicacies) with beer, plus karaage
w: Ura-Tennōji standing bar whose walls are papered with Tanabata-style tanzaku menu strips listing ~230 regional delicacies; Kansai Walker calls it Tennōji's signature tachinomi, and Osaka Metro's metronine includes it on its Ura-Tennōji bar-hop.

dish: freshly brewed Asahi beer tasting at the end of the brewery tour (foam-art café)
n: Asahi Beer Museum (アサヒビール ミュージアム, Suita Brewery)
w: Hands-on museum opened 25 April 2022 inside the Suita brewery, Asahi's birthplace; free, reservation-only tours end with a tasting of beer straight from the plant. Covered by OSAKA-INFO and a Time Out opening story.

dish: pick-your-own shiitake grilled over charcoal at the adjoining barbecue house (vegetables, domestic beef sets)
n: Takatsuki Shiitake Center (高槻しいたけセンター)
address: Takatsuki-shi (near the 森林センター前 bus stop, Takatsuki forest area), Osaka
w: Year-round shiitake-picking farm in the Takatsuki hills; you pay by weight and grill your haul at the BBQ house next door — featured by OSAKA-INFO and in Rurubu's Kansai shiitake-picking & BBQ round-up.

dish: niku-shōyu ramen (shoyu ramen topped with 150 g of low-temperature pork shoulder) on house noodles
w: Toyonaka's influential noodle-maker ramen shop (vacuum-mixed house noodles, whole-chicken + dashi soup) whose alumni run Tokyo's Gantetsu; a Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2025 pick, and Kansai Walker's Toyonaka–Itami ramen feature includes it.

dish: honke kushikatsu — beef skewers in a panko-free, flour-only batter fried in beef tallow (fluffy, corn-dog-like), with house sweet-spicy sauce
n: Ōmiya Honten (近江屋本店, Shinsekai kushikatsu)
w: Long-standing Shinsekai kushikatsu shop loved by locals for its unique no-panko batter; Rurubu counts it among Shinsekai's four great old kushikatsu houses and Mapple's Osaka kushikatsu round-up includes it.
